bans.tabBans: Players who cannot join the server. A ban covers the whole account, so they cannot join with any character until it ends or you lift it.
bans.tabBlocks: Single characters that are suspended: the owner can still join with another character, but cannot play this one until you lift it.
bans.search: Filters the list by what you type: the player name, the reason, the staff member, the license or the ban number.

filter.active: Bans in force right now, permanent and temporary. These players cannot join at the moment.
filter.permanent: Bans with no end: they stay until a staff member lifts them on this page.
filter.temporary: Bans with a length: they end by themselves at the time shown, then the player can join.
filter.expired: Bans whose time is over. The player can join now; the line stays in the list for reference only.
filter.all: Every ban line: in force and ended.

col.id: The ban's number on the server. Use it to point to one ban or to find it in the admin log.
col.name: The account name at the time of the ban, with the license under it, which identifies the account even if the name changes.
col.reason: The reason the staff member wrote. The player sees it every time they try to join.
col.by: The staff member who placed the ban.
col.ends: When the player can join again. Permanent never ends; Ended means they can join now.
col.actions: What you can do with each line. Point at a button to see its own explanation.

unban.text: Lifts the ban so the player can join right away with any character. For an ended ban it only clears the line from the list.
unban.undo: No; to restore it you must ban them again while they are online

bans.drawer: The full details of the chosen ban: the whole reason, the license and when it ends.

license.text: A fixed number of the player's Rockstar account. The ban is tied to it, so it holds even if the player changes their name.

bans.remaining: How long is left until the ban ends, from now. After that the player can join without you doing anything.
bans.findChars: Opens Characters and searches by this license, so you see every character of the account. Changes nothing.
bans.openPlayers: Opens Players. A ban itself is placed from the player's file while they are online, under Moderation.

blocks.search: Filters the list by citizen ID, character name, reason or staff member.

col.cid: The fixed citizen ID of the suspended character, with the session number # beside it when the owner is online now.
col.name: The suspended character's name, and under it whether the owner is in the server now.
col.reason: The reason the staff member wrote. The owner sees it when they try to pick this character.
col.by: The staff member who suspended the character.
col.since: How long the character has been suspended. A suspension has no end date; it stays until staff lift it.

unblock.text: Lifts the suspension so the owner can pick this character and play it again.
unblock.undo: Yes, suspend it again with Suspend a character

blocks.open: Opens the character in Characters to see its details and belongings. Changes nothing.

new.text: Suspends one character by citizen ID: the owner cannot play it until you lift it, and if they are playing it now they leave the server.
new.example: 14 suspends character 14, or #5 the character of the player online in session 5
new.undo: Yes, lift it from this list

who.text: The character you want to suspend. Type the citizen ID like 14, or # and the session number like #5 for a player online now.

blocks.reason: Why the character is suspended. The owner sees it when trying to pick the character, and it is kept in the admin log.
blocks.drawer: The chosen suspension: the character, the reason, who suspended it and when.

bans.searchBans: Search by name, reason or license…
bans.searchBlocks: Search by citizen ID, name or reason…
bans.unbanText: "%s" will be able to join the server right away with any character.
bans.unbanTextExpired: This ban has already ended, so this only clears the line from the list.
bans.noMatch: Nothing matches this search or filter.
bans.noneNext: To ban a player, open them in Players, then Moderation.
bans.waiting: Waiting for the ban list from the server…

blocks.unblockText: The owner will be able to pick this character and play it again.
blocks.newText: The owner cannot play this character until you lift it here. If they are playing it now, they leave the server.
blocks.needOne: Type the citizen ID of an existing character first.
blocks.already: This character is already suspended; the new suspension replaces its reason.
blocks.noneNext: Suspend one with Suspend a character, or from Characters.
blocks.waiting: Waiting for the suspension list from the server…
